name: Amelia Arlington
source: Lady Amelia Arlington is the President and Dean of Arlington Academy, as well as the head of the Business, Commerce and Politics Department. She has a mysterious side to her that very few have been able to decipher. She is very strict, powerful and rich. If you are a good student, you have nothing to fear.
